mainEntity.name: How do I know if my basement floor has moisture problems before installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moisture testing is one of the most important pieces of evidence, especially in Colorado basements. A simple plastic-sheet test can reveal vapor transmission, but a full assessment should also check for staining, damp spots, odors, and any history of leaks near plumbing or exterior walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use moisture testing, including a plastic-sheet check, and inspect for stains, dampness, and odors. If the slab shows vapor or past leak signs, choose a more moisture-tolerant flooring system.
